issues.title: [Codex Astra] Backend and integration: authoritative match slice
issues.body:
## Runner and team

Run this task in **Codex Astra**. The agreed team is Codex Astra for Backend/Integration and three separate Claude Code sessions for Frontend, Visual/Motion Design and Game Design/Balance. See [agent roster](https://github.com/Amirkianfar66/GameN/blob/main/docs/agent-roster.md). Select the model in the tool; these instructions do not launch or switch a model.

Start after bootstrap #1 is reviewed and merged, using its exact resulting commit in an isolated checkout/worktree. Read AGENTS.md and the Backend brief. As integration owner, obtain affected-role review of shared changes.

## Outcome

Server-authoritative match slice and command contract.

## Assignment

- Workstream: backend
- Branch: `agent/backend-foundation`
- Brief: [agents/backend.md](https://github.com/Amirkianfar66/GameN/blob/main/agents/backend.md)
- Specification: [docs/backend/first-slice.md](https://github.com/Amirkianfar66/GameN/blob/main/docs/backend/first-slice.md)
- Verified source import: `7e28c2cd100642667fb0021be0b85fa8cade1869`.
- Rule-source manifest SHA-256: `34e7c08cda13dcc329f7a1d5f7656ab59db1fc834460b5ad9d3590619b5479cc`.
- Implementation baseline: the reviewed bootstrap from #1; record its actual commit before starting.

## Scope

- [ ] Draft command, receipt, per-audience projection and deadline contracts for integration review.
- [ ] Implement the pure engine and Firebase adapter for the approved nine-seat Officer/Protection fixture.
- [ ] Prove idempotency, private/public boundaries, phase deadlines and reconnect recovery with executable evidence.

## Dependencies

- Shared workspace and contracts from [bootstrap #1](https://github.com/Amirkianfar66/GameN/issues/1).

- Shared contracts reviewed by Frontend and Game Balance.
- Exact private-disclosure and relevant resolution semantics settled for the chosen fixture.

## Acceptance

Follow the role brief and specification. Report only actual checks and measurements. A seeded nine-seat fixture with two controlled clients is not a new two-player mode. Preserve current rule overlays and secret-information boundaries.

## Execution

Use the corresponding launch prompt in [CODEX_START_HERE.md](https://github.com/Amirkianfar66/GameN/blob/main/CODEX_START_HERE.md) and a separate checkout/branch. Creating this issue does not launch an autonomous task. Preserve English UI and the comic motion direction. Record actual checks and unresolved decisions in the PR.
